result.title: SessionFollowResult
result.description: Atomic join result for a session stream. `mode=snapshot` carries the exact history terminal reply and the revision at that ordered boundary. params.title: EngineReadThreadHistoryParams
params.description:
Read complete durable messages without activating their provider or a writer.

Turn paging: pages are slices of the oldest-first turn sequence, `cursor` names the turn the NEXT page starts at, and an unknown cursor is refused rather than silently re-reading from the head. `itemsView` bounds what each message carries: `full` (the default) keeps every block, `summary` keeps the turn's first user and last assistant message, and `notLoaded` keeps turn membership only. Summary selection clones the chosen messages whole, so a first user message still carries its own image blocks. Replies may also carry `presentationRecords`: the returned users' matching `user_display` records, separate from raw history membership and page limits.

sortDirection.description: Turn traversal order. `desc` (the default) walks from the newest turn towards the oldest, `asc` from the oldest towards the newest; the cursor names the turn the page starts at in that direction.

params.title: EngineReadThreadItemsParams
